channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: ‘De-escalation’: Europe hesitates as US pushes for Hormuz naval mission
item.description: The UK and France are not seeking confrontation with Iran in the US-Israeli war Europe largely rejected, say analysts.

item.title: Several killed after student opens fire inside Thailand school
item.description: At least eight people were killed and 15 others injured after a student opened fire inside a school in Thailand.

item.title: Earthquake strikes as doctors perform surgery
item.description: A viral video shows medical staff protecting a patient as an earthquake struck Japan during surgery.

item.title: ‘Still searching for truth’: Daughter of Sikh activist killed 30 years ago
item.description: Jaswant Singh Khalra's daughter Navkiran reflects on slain father's life and legacy, which also inspired a recent film.

item.title: Bodies of climbers killed in avalanche retrieved from Broad Peak
item.description: A search team has retrieved the remains of renowned climber Nirmal Purja and several members of his team.

item.title: At least five killed in Thailand school shooting, police say
item.description: Authorities say suspected gunman shot and ⁠killed his grandparents ​at their home before opening fire at the school.

item.title: Brazil formally accuses 16 people over 2024 Voepass deadly plane crash
item.description: Official says plane was irregularly cleared for departure before crash that killed 62 people outside Sao Paulo.

item.title: Iran war live: Trump says Iran can’t ‘go on much longer’; Hormuz deal close
item.description: The US, Iran and Oman are close to a temporary deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Thousands of migrants still in Ceuta after border crisis, local leader says
item.description: The Spanish territory's mayor-president also says 100 deaths occurred as a result of 78,000 migrants crossing from neighbouring Morocco.

item.title: Israel charges settler over killing of Palestinian involved in Oscar-winning West Bank film
item.description: Yinon Levy is charged with reckless manslaughter over the July 2025 shooting of Odeh Hathaleen.
